definitions.labeled_fiber: LABELED_FIBER(T;s,t) consists of endpoint-fixed histories that use every proof token exactly once, respecting token source/target, and whose packet projection lies in F(T;s,t).
definitions.projection: pi deletes proof-token labels and retains the full ordered packet history.
definitions.token_set: For every ordered pair (x,y) with T(x,y)=m>0, E_{x,y}={e_{x,y,1},...,e_{x,y,m}}.

self_loop_handling: If T(x,x)=m, the m proof tokens e_{x,x,k} are distinguishable only in the lift; all project to the same raw x->x transition occurrence type.
